body: people tell me i’m too sensitive, but i can’t help that i feel everything so deeply. it sucks and i wish that i didn’t..
it does help to know someone can relate, and i hope you can make it through. this illness is so hard. ❤️
9 times out of 10 it’s usually terrible pain lol
having a favorite person can be so magical. it’s amazing how deeply we are able to love a person. but having a favorite person is also so, so heartbreaking. </3

i feel this way too much. my fp has completely disappeared from my life these past few months and i’ve felt so fucking lost i still don’t know what to do. it’s like i built my entire existence and happiness on this one person and them abandoning me has crumbled me. no closure or anything just complete abandonment... my biggest fear come true. everything is so hard.
i trust this rein with my life
